strings.GGN_THENEWORDER_DESC:
On September 1, 1939, Poland's nightmare entered a terrifying new stage as German tanks rolled across the border. Crushed under the Nazi jackboot, Poland soon became the staging ground for some of the greatest atrocities ever recorded. Inconspicuous Polish fields became sites of huge death camps, vacuuming up Jews and Poles and leaving devastation in their wake. Poles were starved, beaten and worked to death to serve the German war effort.

Then, after it was all over, all the remaining Poles were crammed into the Generalgouvernement, a cruel and stunted mockery of their old nation. As German colonists poured across the Weichsel, the Poles settled down into an existence of servitude under the watchful eye of Hans Frank. As a symbol of Poland's place in this new world order, the proud city of Warsaw was slowly bulldozed. For all the world knew, Poland was no more - another victim of Nazi brutality.

In 1962, though, there are stirrings in this battered nation. Hans Frank's once hawkish eye wanders towards securing his own legacy, and the Nazi apparatus in both Germany and the East is descending into factionalism and infighting. As the Germans squabble, the Polish partisans reassert themselves. The famed Home Army, never destroyed despite the Germans' best efforts, eats away at the legitimacy of the German state in the shadows. Joined in an uneasy alliance by the communist People's Army and the far-right National Armed Forces, they are eager to take the fight to the Germans.

Can Poland undergo an unlikely renaissance, or will it be just another tragedy in this most blood-soaked of centuries?
strings.GGN_national_socialism_party_long: Arbeitsbereich Generalgouvernement der Nationalsozialistischen Deutschen Arbeiterpartei
strings.GGN_Underground_State_desc:
Decades ago, the Wehrmacht overran Europe in a storm never seen before. Poland fought them bravely, odds stacked sky-high against them, until the bitter end - and with that end, the light of the Polish nation extinguished forever.

Or that is what most of the world believes.

Over the decades, it has become increasingly clear to Hans Frank's government in Krakau and a few watchful eyes beyond it that the Polish nation survives, nay, thrives in the shadows. Aided by the sheer incompetence of the General Government and their own shrewdness, the Polish Underground State is an ever-growing thorn in the side of the Reich and its hegemony over the Polish lands.

And they have a clear goal.
strings.GGN_terrified_garrison_desc: The German garrison has been paralyzed by fear, and has reached the point where they refuse to even do the most menial tasks.
strings.GGN_government_in_flames_desc: The garrison has been thrown into crisis following the attempt on Hitler's life, with many fearing that the Polish underground government has returned.
strings.GGN_unstable_government_desc: The garrison has calmed down somewhat, and has begun to start actually patrolling Poland.
strings.GGN_underground_government_desc: We can not find them, we do not know who they are, but we are no fools! We know of the dastardly Poles and their secret government which has been guiding their foul partisans from behind the scenes for years! But while we do not admit it, it is becoming clear that if we are to ever gain control of the nation, we must destroy them! For now, however, we must just keep our heads above water, until the Fatherland comes to our aid!
strings.GGN_tooltip_1: The Underground State will work against you...
strings.GGN_not_fine: Disaster has been averted, for now...
strings.GGN_end_of_the_line: The Poles may not have been as weak as previously thought...
strings.GGN_its_time: When the time is right, the Secret Government will strike out against the garrison!
strings.GGN_victory: The Generaulgouvernment has defeated the Polish revolt
